Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS/OBSERVED UI: Arrow keys move one tile; held/repeated presses were issued individually. Text/objects can be pushed when applicable. Return enters a map node after Baba is fully on it and its title appears; winning automatically returns to the island map, so Return on the celebration screen was often rejected as stale. Map entry then shows a zoom/iris transition. Space and Return did nothing on an intermediate path position. Follow dotted path geometry: from node 00, Right then Up/Up reached 01; direct Up initially did nothing.

COMPLETED LEVELS:
• 00: Rules BABA IS YOU, FLAG IS WIN, WALL IS STOP, ROCK IS PUSH. Pushed middle rock right twice, went Up around it via top row, descended beside flag, moved Right onto it.
• 01 WHERE DO I GO?: Broke WALL IS STOP by pushing STOP left; observed disabled walls become passable. Rearranged loose text into horizontal FLAG IS WIN on row above flag, leaving flag accessible, then touched flag. Initial plan to place IS on flag’s row was rejected because it could obstruct access.
• 02 NOW WHAT IS THIS?: The blue wall object was the controllable YOU entity (WALL IS YOU), not Baba. Pushed STOP left to break FLAG IS STOP; observed flags then became passable. Moved WIN from upper room down to bottom row and left beneath FLAG IS, activating FLAG IS WIN; guided wall right onto sparkling boundary flag.
• 04 STILL OUT OF REACH: Escaped left skull enclosure by pushing three vertically stacked rocks upward. Used rocks as a remote pushing chain on IS’s row to displace IS and break SKULL IS DEFEAT while Baba stayed off skulls. Observed rocks can overlap skulls safely; with DEFEAT disabled Baba crossed skulls and touched flag. A two-rock follow-up was unsafe because Baba would step onto a skull; the successful chain used all three rocks.

CURRENT LEVEL 03 — OUT OF REACH:
Observed active rules: BABA IS YOU, WALL IS STOP, WATER IS SINK, ROCK IS PUSH, FLAG IS WIN. Initial room contained Baba and two rocks; water blocked the exit and surrounded the flag. Baba circled around the lower rock rather than pushing it toward the right wall, pushed it left into the central water-exit column, then pushed it down from above. Observed result: rock and central water tile disappeared together, confirming a rock can sink with water and leave a passable tile. Baba crossed that cleared tile, exited into the left/lower chamber, and moved toward the lower-right text room. Latest observed position: Baba just above the central entrance to that text room. The second rock remains untouched/preserved in the upper original enclosure.

ACTIVE GOAL/WORKING HYPOTHESIS: Reach the text room and replace PUSH with WIN to create ROCK IS WIN, then return through the cleared water tile and touch the preserved rock. Previously proposed sequence: push PUSH up once, circle to approach WIN from below/right, push WIN up three times beneath ROCK IS. This rule-editing sequence and exact push counts remain unverified. Do not spend the remaining rock on water unless the plan changes; it is intended as the winning object. Directly reaching the original flag across its surrounding water has not been demonstrated.
